title: Hospital billing service fee miscalculated
description: The hospital billing system computes a 6.5% service fee, but it is applied to the wrong base amount. Find and fix the bug in src/program_task01.cbl.

title: Two interacting bugs in insurance payout logic
description: Patients are sometimes wrongly denied, and some approved patients owe more than they should. Two separate bugs exist in src/program_task04.cbl; fixing one naively can worsen the other.
